source: Manually reviewed original Tomb of the Golden Skull, all 33 combat groups and rules pages 245–255. Item flags are simulator modifiers only; shared inventory and equipment are unchanged. Escape43 uses the general printed2STAMINA rule.

entry.label: HILL GIANT (§3)
printedRules: The Hill Giant hurls the rock straight at you, but you are unable to jump out of the way in time. It thumps into your chest, knocking you off your feet. Lose 4 STAMINA points. If you are still alive, you drag yourself up to defend yourself against the raging Hill Giant who bears down on you, swinging his huge sword.
If you win, turn to 181.

entry.label: WILD DOG (§12)
printedRules: You cannot stop yourself from falling off your horse, and you land sprawling on the ground. The Wild Dogs attack you from all sides with their long teeth tearing at your flesh. Lose 3 STAMINA points. You struggle to stand up but manage to draw your sword and fend off the Dogs and attack the leader of the pack.
If you win, turn to 371.

entry.label: GIANT SNAKE (§41)
printedRules: You try to sidestep out of the way of the lunging Snake, but you are too slow and it sinks its long fangs into your leg. Lose 2 STAMINA points. You must fight the GIANT SNAKE.
If the Giant Snake wins two Attack Rounds in succession, turn to 349. If you win without losing two Attack Rounds in succession, turn to 101.

entry.label: RAZOR SHARK (§42)
printedRules: If you did not lose an Attack Round fighting the Shark, turn to 204. If you lost one or more Attack Rounds fighting the Shark, a giant RAZOR SHARK is attracted by the smell of blood and propels itself towards you. You must fight it with your Attack Strength reduced by 3 during each Attack Round.
If you win, turn to 204.

bypass.label: No rounds lost against the previous Shark

entry.label: First PIRATE / Second PIRATE (§43)
printedRules: Fighting the PIRATES without a weapon is not going to be easy. Lose 2 LUCK points. You manage to wriggle free from the Pirates’ grip, but you must fight them barehanded one at a time. Reduce your Attack Strength by 3 during each Attack Round.
If you win, turn to 82. You may Escape after defeating one of the Pirates by running down the gangplank (turn to 275).

entry.label: HILL GIANT (§57)
printedRules: The Hill Giant hurls the rock straight at you, but you just manage to jump out of the way in time to avoid being hit. You stand your ground ready to defend yourself against the raging Hill Giant who bears down on you, swinging his huge sword.
If you win, turn to 181.

entry.label: MINOTAUR (§68)
printedRules: When he sees you reach for your sword, the hermit steps back and blows hard on his horn. You hear a loud, piercing note that reverberates through the woods. There is a sudden puff of smoke through which steps a fearsome-looking creature, half-man and half-bull, with a huge pair of curved horns. It’s a MINOTAUR! The hermit slams his door shut and appears at the window smiling as his guardian charges head down at you, snorting loudly.
If you win, turn to 319. You may Escape after three Attack Rounds by running off deeper into the woods. Lose 2 STAMINA points and turn to 387.

entry.label: ROCK GRUB (§92)
printedRules: You hear a grinding sound coming from down the tunnel and the thought of coming face-to-face with Plague Spiders fills you with fear. But it is not a deadly arachnid that you encounter. A giant maggot-like creature with a gaping mouth and powerful mandibles bursts through the tunnel wall up ahead and slithers towards you. It is virtually blind but aware of your presence through sensing your body heat. It is a ROCK GRUB and you must fight it.
If you win, turn to 352.

entry.label: PLAGUE SPIDER (§98)
printedRules: The Plague Spiders run blindly at you with their repulsive fungal tubes bulging. You draw your sword just as the first Plague Spider bears down on you ready to strike with its fangs. You must fight it.
If you win without losing any Attack Rounds, turn to 145. If you win but lost one or more Attack Rounds, turn to 365.

entry.label: LICH (§125)
printedRules: As you approach the crumbling ruins of what was once a southern fortress, you see a wind-eroded sign carved in the sandstone that says Rabeshar. The roofs are long gone and not many of the rooms remain intact with the wind howling through the gaps of missing windows. You clamber over a pile of stones from a broken wall into the main building and are suddenly confronted by a skeletal figure in ragged robes wielding a scythe. Its grey flesh is hanging off its bones, and it makes hideous gurgling noises as it closes in on you. The undead creature is a LICH and you must fight it. Add 1 to your Attack Strength during each Attack Round if you possess a silver dagger.
If you win, turn to 346.

entry.label: WEREWOLF (§126)
printedRules: You are woken in the middle of the night by a howling. The fire is nothing more than the red glow of dying embers, but there’s a full moon and you are able to see across the plain in the pale light. You hear low growling and sense movement nearby, and stand up to draw your sword. A hairy creature, humanoid in shape, suddenly emerges from the shadows, walking upright on its powerful hind legs. The beast is a savage WEREWOLF which leaps forward to slash and bite you with its long claws and sharp fangs.
If you win without losing an Attack Round, turn to 396. If you lost one or more Attack Rounds, turn to 267.

entry.label: GIANT SNAKE (§129)
printedRules: You grab your dagger with your free hand and begin stabbing at the Giant Snake’s body. It recoils quickly, allowing you to stand up and attack the wounded Snake with your sword.
If you win, turn to 101.

entry.label: BARBARIAN (§132)
printedRules: You try to explain that you had no choice, but Thawne won’t listen. He flies into a blinding rage and launches a frenzied attack on you.
If you win, turn to 285.

entry.label: First PLAGUE SPIDER / Second PLAGUE SPIDER (§145)
printedRules: You hardly have time to think before the other two Plague Spiders bear down on you. Fight them one at a time.
If you win without losing any Attack Rounds, turn to 392. If you win but lost one or more Attack Rounds, turn to 160.

entry.label: GIANT SNAKE (§159)
printedRules: You just manage to sidestep out of the way of the lunging Snake and strike it with your sword, causing it a deep wound. It recoils instantly and prepares to strike again. You must fight the GIANT SNAKE.
If the Giant Snake wins two Attack Rounds in succession, turn to 349. If you win without losing two Attack Rounds in succession, turn to 101.

entry.label: ACOLYTE (§164)
printedRules: You walk down the corridor and through the archway into the courtyard. As you walk around the fountain, the door in front of you opens and one of the bald-headed ACOLYTES appears. He draws his long curved knife and runs at you screaming.
If you win, you pick up the Acolyte’s curved knife and slip through the doorway leading to the outside, to escape before more Acolytes appear. Turn to 176.

entry.label: PLAGUE SPIDER (§167)
printedRules: You draw your sword just as the first Plague Spider bears down on you ready to strike with its fangs. You must fight it but are slow to wield your sword and must reduce your Attack Strength by 2 during the first Attack Round.
If you win without losing any Attack Rounds, turn to 145. If you win but lost one or more Attack Rounds, turn to 365.

entry.label: PIRATE CAPTAIN (§168)
printedRules: Captain Shankin moves slowly but his cutlass skills are excellent. Fighting him barehanded means you must reduce your Attack Strength by 3 during each Attack Round.
If you win, turn to 106. You may Escape after three Attack Rounds by running down the gangplank. Lose 2 STAMINA points and turn to 275.

entry.label: WILD DOG (§217)
printedRules: You just manage to stay in the saddle and keep control of your horse. The growling WILD DOGS circle you, their slavering jaws wide open revealing long sharp teeth. You urge your horse on, but it refuses to move. You have no choice but to jump down and take on the WILD DOGS with your sword. The leader of the pack leaps at you as soon as your feet touch the ground.
If you win without losing an Attack Round, turn to 283. If you win but lost one or more Attack Rounds, turn to 371.

entry.label: VALMORKA (§220)
printedRules: You gulp down the contents of the bottle and hear Valmorka’s blood-curdling howl when she loses sight of you as the Potion of Invisibility takes effect. You seize the moment and run forward with your sword raised to battle the screaming Demon. If your sword is a Dragonblade, add 5 to your Attack Strength during the first three Attack Rounds before the effects of the potion wear off. Add 3 to your Attack Strength during all Attack Rounds thereafter. If you do not possess a Dragonblade, add 2 to your Attack Strength during the first three Attack Rounds until the effects of the potion wear off, with no Attack Strength bonus during Attack Rounds thereafter.
If you win, turn to 374.

entry.label: First PLAGUE SPIDER / Second PLAGUE SPIDER (§230)
printedRules: You stand for a moment waiting for your body to react to the bite, but nothing happens. Chewing Arrika Root has made you immune to the bite of the Zombie predator. You sigh with relief but hardly have time to think before the other two Plague Spiders bear down on you. Fight them one at a time with the reassuring knowledge that you will not turn into a Zombie yourself.
If you win, turn to 392.

entry.label: First SEA BANDIT / Second SEA BANDIT (§234)
printedRules: Your aim is poor on the rocking boat, and the spear flies past the Bandit and lands harmlessly in the sea. He lets loose another arrow from close range, which strikes you in the shoulder. Lose 2 STAMINA points. The canoe comes alongside the boat and two of the SEA BANDITS jump aboard brandishing their cutlasses. The boat is narrow, and you can fight them one at a time.
If you win, turn to 11.

entry.label: SHARK (§270)
printedRules: You try to plug the leak but cannot stop the boat from sinking. As you float out to sea, you catch your calf on a rusty nail as the boat goes down. You swim towards the shore and suddenly feel a terrible pain in your lower leg. Attracted by the smell of your blood, a SHARK powers through the water and bites a chunk out of your calf. Lose 4 STAMINA points. If you are still alive, you pull the knife from your belt to defend yourself. Fighting the Shark in the rough sea is challenging, and you must reduce your Attack Strength by 2 during each Attack Round.
If you win, turn to 42.

entry.label: CITY GUARD (§271)
printedRules: The GUARD looks surprised to see you draw your sword but reacts quickly and thrusts his spear at you.
You may Escape after two Attack Rounds (lose 2 STAMINA points and turn to 294), or if you win, you must fight the other GUARDS who are closing in on you (turn to 344).

entry.label: HIGH PRIEST (§289)
printedRules: You dash down the corridor relieved to have obtained your treasure so easily when you bump into an Acolyte coming the other way. It is the HIGH PRIEST. He looks startled, but quickly recovers and, aware of the theft, runs at you wielding two wickedly curved blades.

If you win, you make a hasty exit through the archway into the courtyard before any other Acolytes come running. Passing the fountain to the doorway, you close the door behind you and run down the path into the jungle to head east. Turn to 176.

entry.label: TERRORHAWK (§299)
printedRules: You urge your horse into a steady gallop across the grassland and are making good progress when you see something high in the sky. A huge TERRORHAWK is circling above you. It suddenly swoops down, screeching loudly, with its long, curved talons outstretched. You jump down from your horse to defend yourself.

If you are still alive after three Attack Rounds you watch the TERRORHAWK bank away and fly off north in search of easier prey. While you were fighting, your horse bolted and galloped back towards Halak. You decide against chasing after your horse and set off on foot towards the trees. Turn to 91.

entry.label: THORNBACK FIEND (§309)
printedRules: You pick up the pace, walking through the arid landscape, but stop in your tracks when you see what you think is a bush move. For a moment you think it is a trick of the light but then you see it rise up. It’s not a bush but a dark-green creature with tiny eyes and a wide, fanged mouth. Its head and back are covered with long, needle-like quills. It is a vicious THORNBACK FIEND. It hesitates for a moment, sniffing the air, before rushing forward and releasing a hail of quills at you. Roll one die to determine how many of its poison-tipped quills hit you and reduce your STAMINA points total by the number rolled. If you are still alive, you must fight the fierce creature, which attacks you with its long, slashing claws.

In addition to using its claws, the Thornback will fire more quills at you during each Attack Round. You must roll one die to determine how many quills hit you each round, reducing your STAMINA points total by the number rolled. If you win, turn to 333.

entry.label: VALMORKA (§343)
printedRules: You run forward with your sword raised to battle the screaming Demon. If your sword is a Dragonblade, add 3 to your Attack Strength during each Attack Round.
If you win, turn to 374.

entry.label: First CITY GUARD / Second CITY GUARD (§344)
printedRules: The Captain of the Guard orders his men to close in and attack you with their spears. You must fight them one at a time.
If you win, the Captain of the Guard takes flight. You seize your chance and run south down the street. Turn to 263.

entry.label: GOBLIN (§355)
printedRules: You run at the Goblin, swinging your sword above your head. The Goblin turns to defend himself, standing ready with his glowing warhammer.
If you win, turn to 287.

entry.label: First GIANT RAT / Second GIANT RAT / Third GIANT RAT (§357)
printedRules: Apart from the sighting of a large eel in the river, the walk along the bank is uneventful. Ahead, there is a bend in the river where you see old bones and debris scattered about. You hear high-pitched squeaks and suddenly three GIANT RATS, each over a metre long, run up the bank to attack you with their sharp teeth and claws. You must fight them one at a time.
If you win, turn to 24.

entry.label: GIANT LIZARD (§368)
printedRules: The bridge is made of bamboo and vines and looks sturdy. You step on to it and it begins to sway as you cross. You don’t stop, and hurry across to the other side. The route north along the river looks perilous so you decide to head east into the jungle. It’s a hot day. The air is clammy, which makes you sweat and your clothes stick to you uncomfortably. You stop to drink water from your flask and become aware of something moving nearby. The undergrowth in front of you is suddenly trampled underfoot by a GIANT LIZARD that scurries towards you, its huge fang-filled mouth open and ready to devour you. You must fight it.
If you win, turn to 223.

entry.label: Treeman, first branch / Treeman, second branch (§387)
printedRules: It is getting dark and, with the shadows creeping in, the light is beginning to play tricks on you with the bushes and branches swaying in the wind. You forge on through the woods in the semi-gloom when, suddenly, a branch from one of the trees whips round and knocks you off your feet. A tree trunk shuffles forward, and you see a pair of tiny eyes staring at you angrily as you are hit again by another branch. Lose 1 STAMINA point. You have been assailed by a TREEMAN whose territory you have invaded. You must defend yourself from its flailing branches.
You must defeat the Treeman twice, once for each main branch. If you win, turn to 18. You may Escape after winning any Attack Round by running off. Lose 2 STAMINA points and turn to 229.
